definition: Enterprise value (public) or post-money (private) divided by revenue or run-rate, per layer (Appendix C, P1 §6.1).
name: Valuation to revenue by layer
timing_rationale: Leading: the market's multiple prices where rents are expected to sit before margins do.
tracker_interpretation: The model layer's version is lab_valuation_to_run_rate.
unpublished_reason: Not measurable across layers from free sources: Epoch's post-money and run-rate rows cover model-layer companies only, so a by-layer multiple collapses to lab_valuation_to_run_rate; application- and infrastructure-layer private multiples need Sacra or PitchBook revenue (paid stubs off), and public EV/revenue needs a market-value source the tracker does not ingest.
why_it_matters: Where the market expects the rent to sit.
